# Field (`field`)

Label, helper, error and success around any control.

Group: Text inputs. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/text-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createField` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/field.d.ts`): `.mh-field`: a label above, a message below (helper, error or success) and an optional counter, around any control. Wires `for`/`id` (or `aria-labelledby`), `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid` and `aria-required`. The message is a polite live region, so errors set later are announced.

```ts
export function createField(options: FieldOptions): FieldHandle;

export interface FieldOptions {
  /** The visible label. */
  label: string;
  /** The control: an input, select or textarea, or any element containing one (e.g. `.mh-input`). */
  control: HTMLElement;
  /**
   * The element the label and messages describe. Default: `control` when it is an input, select or textarea, else
   * the first one inside it, else `control` itself (labelled through `aria-labelledby`).
   */
  target?: HTMLElement;
  /** A hint under the control. */
  helper?: string;
  /** An error message; marks the control `aria-invalid`. Wins over `success`. */
  error?: string;
  /** A confirmation message under the control. */
  success?: string;
  /** Shows a required marker and sets `required` / `aria-required`. */
  required?: boolean;
  /** Label style: a regular label (default) or a small mono, uppercase eyebrow. */
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  /** Reserves a character counter at the end of the footer (see `setCount`). */
  counter?: boolean;
}

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createTextField` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/textField.d.ts`): `.mh-input` (`--sm | --lg`) inside a `.mh-field`: a single-line text input with an optional icon, prefix, suffix and counter. States: `:focus-within`, `[aria-invalid]`, `:disabled`. Height follows `--mh-control-*`.

```ts
export function createTextField(options: TextFieldOptions): TextFieldHandle;

export interface TextFieldOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`; the field then renders the box alone. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  value?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  type?: TextFieldType;
  name?: string;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  success?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  size?: InputSize;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  /** A leading icon (decorative). */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Text before the value, e.g. a currency sign. */
  prefix?: string;
  /** Text after the value, e.g. a unit. */
  suffix?: string;
  maxLength?: number;
  /** Shows a character counter (with `maxLength`, `n / max`). */
  showCount?: boolean;
  autocomplete?: string;
  inputMode?: string;
  onInput?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
  onChange?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface TextFieldHandle {
  /** The field (or the bare box without a label). */
  el: HTMLElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  getValue(): string;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createField, createTextField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const name = createTextField({ value: 'Living room' });
const field = createField({
  label: 'Display name',
  control: name.el,
  helper: 'Shown on the dashboard.',
  required: true,
});

// Validate when the user leaves the input; the message is a live region, so the error is announced.
name.input.addEventListener('change', () => {
  field.setError(name.getValue().trim() ? undefined : 'Enter a name.');
});

document.body.append(field.el);
```

## React API

`Field` (types in `dist/react/text-inputs.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createField`.

```ts
export function Field({ label, helper, error, success, required, labelStyle, count, disabled, controlId, group, children, className, ...rest }: FieldProps);

export interface FieldProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children'> {
  label: ReactNode;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  success?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  /** Counter text (see `fieldCountText`); the counter is rendered when this is set. */
  count?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** The control's id; generated otherwise. */
  controlId?: string;
  /** The control is not an input, select or textarea: the label becomes a span the control references. */
  group?: boolean;
  /** The control, or a function that receives the ids and ARIA to spread onto it. */
  children: ReactNode | ((control: FieldControlProps) => ReactNode);
}

/** What `Field` passes to its control: spread these onto the input, select or textarea. */
export interface FieldControlProps {
  id: string;
  'aria-describedby'?: string;
  'aria-invalid'?: true;
  'aria-labelledby'?: string;
  'aria-required'?: true;
  required?: boolean;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Field, TextField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function FieldExample() {
  const [name, setName] = useState('Living room');
  return (
    <Field label="Display name" helper="Shown on the dashboard." error={name.trim() ? undefined : 'Enter a name.'} required>
      {(control) => <TextField {...control} value={name} onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)} />}
    </Field>
  );
}
```
